annotation.title_clean: Egypt National Artificial Intelligence Strategy Second Edition (2025-2030)
annotation.title_en: Egypt National Artificial Intelligence Strategy Second Edition (2025-2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Council for Artificial Intelligence (NCAI), Egypt
annotation.venue: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology / NCAI
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Egypt's second National AI Strategy (2025-2030), issued by the National Council for AI, sets a vision of inclusive AI and a national Arabic foundation model. It organises 21 initiatives under six pillars (governance, technology, data, infrastructure, ecosystem, talent), including an AI law, a responsible-AI centre and charter. Robotics gets only passing mention.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six pillars and 21 initiatives: governance, technology, data, ICT/AI infrastructure, ecosystem, talents
Draft Egypt AI Law to protect citizens against high-risk or prohibited AI and create a regulatory body
Center for Responsible AI and detailed guidelines under the Egyptian Charter for Responsible AI, aligned with OECD principles
Optimise Data Protection Law (No. 151 of 2020) and establish a Personal Data Protection Authority
Develop a national Arabic foundation model; targets of 30,000 AI professionals and 250+ AI companies by 2030
